title: CherenkovLens
description: End-to-end Python simulation, topological image cleaning, Hillas parameter extraction, and machine learning classification pipeline for Imaging Atmospheric Cherenkov Telescopes (IACTs), modeled on the MACE gamma-ray observatory in Hanle, Ladakh.

title: Reliability-Lab
description: Enterprise-grade research platform for stochastic structural reliability engineering, rare-event probability estimation (Pf ∈ [10⁻⁹, 10⁻²]), multivariate copula dependence modeling, surrogate models, system reliability block diagram analysis, and automated numerical provenance reporting.

title: firetwin
description: Coupled Multiphysics Engineering Simulator uniting Incompressible Boussinesq Navier-Stokes CFD, Large Eddy Simulation (LES), P1 Radiation Transport, Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) Surrogates, Eurocode 3 Structural Degradation, and Helbing Social Force Evacuation.

title: Neural PDE Bench
description: Scientific machine learning platform integrating Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), Operator Learning (FNO, DeepONet, GNO), Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification (HMC & VI), and Score-Based Diffusion Generative Models for forward and inverse partial differential equations.

title: Nonlinear FEA Studio
description: Advanced computational structural mechanics platform covering geometrically & materially nonlinear continuum regimes, multiscale RVE homogenization, adjoint topology optimization, reduced-order modeling (ROM), and probabilistic fatigue life assessment with 3D WebGL visualization.
